name: web3_career-deals-mcp
description: web3.career (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_web3_career_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WEB3_CAREER_TOKEN
platform_mcp_web3_career_token.description: Web3.career API token generated at https://web3.career/web3-jobs-api after signing in ('Your token is for your use only … Do not share it'), sent as the token query parameter.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET https://web3.career/api/v1?token=&tag=&limit=&show_description=true (the single documented endpoint). `category` → tag, which must be ONE exact slug from the documented list (solidity, rust, defi, engineering, marketing, …) — 'Invalid tags silently return empty results'. There is no free-text, budget or offset parameter, so query and min_budget are not sent and page is ignored (limit 1–100). The body is a mixed array '[string, string, Job[]]'; jobs are read from element 2 ('typically'). url is apply_url — the required attribution link, never modify it; salary is free text in raw.salary; location/remote in raw.
